result.detail:
Recorded decisions:
(1) pready is tied high, including during reset, as the interface spec requires (zero wait states). This differs from the knowledge note about PREADY low in reset; the block spec takes precedence.
(2) irq is the combinational reduction |(status & INTR_ENABLE) over flops, as the microarchitecture states. It is not separately registered.
(3) PPROT is not a port, matching the interface spec port list.
(4) The formal proof (apb_gpio.sby / apb_gpio_n32.sby in the microarchitecture plan) is deferred. The ifdef FORMAL block in the RTL holds only design-intent assertions and is not a proof setup. A follow-up task or the tech lead should decide whether formal is required before signoff.
Uncertainty sources: exact simulator flags (Icarus $error support, Verilator --timing), and possible lint warnings I could not run against.
